column4: Route bootstrap.sh and setup.sh installation through scripts/mesh-manifest while preserving all current top-level entrypoints, explicit legacy copies, and unit paths. Add isolated temp-repository tests for direct and nested tools, units, and non-deployable assets; verify manifest check, source/deployed basename parity, service ExecStart resolution, and rollback. No file moves in this slice.

Make mesh-sync-tools and mesh-doctor enumerate installable tools and units from the checked manifest with no silent partial-glob fallback. Preserve shim basename ownership. Test nested tools, unknown classifications, duplicate installed basenames, deployed parity, and both --test paths; verify outside-repository invocation. No file moves.

Make mesh-autowire, mesh-land, and mesh-vitality use the shared manifest classification for candidates and coverage while preserving current compatibility paths. Prove unknown rows fail loudly, run focused --test checks, inspect real cadence/reflex resolution, and record rollback. No file moves.

After slices 1-3 pass, census callers and choose one low-fan-in operations wrapper; move only that source into scripts/operations/ and retain an executable top-level shim. Verify no recursive resolution, source/deployed identity, focused --test, doctor/sync/autowire behavior, actual wiring, and inverse-move rollback.

After the pilot passes, migrate communication adapters one family at a time into scripts/communication/. For each family census direct callers, preserve Telegram/board credential boundaries and old paths until callers migrate, then verify syntax, focused tests, deployed parity, and live delivery/service/reflex resolution. Do not batch unrelated families.

Migrate phone, body, network, camera, and external adapters only as isolated device/protocol families into scripts/integrations/. Classify ambiguous watch/platform tools by runtime contract; verify each real sensor --test artifact, freshness/coverage, deployed parity, and no duplicate cadence. Preserve an honest unavailable-sensor result.

After manifest coverage and compatibility shims are proven, migrate core primitives one at a time into scripts/core/. Start each with a full caller census; high-fan-in task, claim, ledger, context, and handoff primitives require focused chain/ledger tests, old-path compatibility checks, deployed parity, and rollback rehearsal.

After runtime paths stabilize, relocate only manifest-classified test drivers/fixtures and UXN sources/assets. Create and validate a UXN build manifest before moving generated ROM/SYM/bin output; run tests from outside repository root and prove production deployment excludes fixtures and assets.

As a separate final migration, retire compatibility shims only after one full deploy/autowire/doctor cycle and a fresh caller census. Prove no old-path callers remain, verify installed basenames plus service/reflex resolution, and rehearse restoration from the previous manifest before removing each shim.
